item.title: Park Jung-sung Named New Trade Minister, Choi Yong-cheol as Fire Agency Chief (신임 통상교섭본부장에 박정성, 소방청장 최용철)
item.description:
Park Jung-sung Named New Trade Minister, Choi Yong-cheol as Fire Agency Chief (신임 통상교섭본부장에 박정성, 소방청장 최용철)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 20th appointed Park Jung-sung, Deputy Trade Minister for Trade, as the new Minister for Trade Negotiations at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE). The appointment follows the dismissal of former Trade Minister Yeo Han-koo last week. (이재명 대통령은 20일 산업통상부(산업부) 통상교섭본부장에 박정성 산업부 통상차관보를 임명했다. 지난주 여한구 전 통상교섭본부장의 면직에 따른 인사다.)

The new Trade Minister Park, a native of Daegu, graduated from Seoul National University's Department of Economics and passed the 40th Higher Civil Service Examination, after which he has consistently worked at MOTIE. He has served as the senior working-level representative of the ministry's task force for U.S. tariff negotiations and as head of the Trade and Investment Office. (박 신임 통상교섭본부장은 대구 출신으로 서울대 경제학과를 졸업, 행정고시 40회에 합격한 뒤 줄곧 산업부에서 일해왔다. 산업부 대미관세협상 TF(태스크포스) 실무수석대표, 무역투자실장 등을 맡았다.)

Kang Yu-jung, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations, said in a written briefing, "Minister Park is a seasoned trade official who has held key positions in trade and trade policy for nearly 30 years," adding, "He has overseen the working-level coordination of tariff and investment negotiations with the U.S., and we judged him to be the right person to maintain continuity in negotiations amid urgent U.S. trade issues and maximize national interests." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 “박 통상교섭본부장은 30년 가까이 통상 및 무역정책 분야 핵심 보직을 두루 거친 정통 통상 관료”라며 “대미 관세 및 투자 협상의 실무 총괄을 맡아와 급박한 대미 통상 현안 속에서 협상의 연속성을 유지하며 국익을 극대화할 적임자로 판단했다”고 밝혔다.)

The President also appointed Choi Yong-cheol, Deputy Commissioner of the National Fire Agency, as its new Commissioner. Choi, a native of Boeun, North Chungcheong Province, graduated from Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, entered the service as a member of the 10th fire officer intake, and has served as head of the South Jeolla Province Fire Headquarters and acting head of the Gyeonggi Province Fire and Disaster Headquarters. He also has experience being dispatched to the National Crisis Management Center under the presidential National Security Office. (이 대통령은 소방청장에는 최용철 소방청 차장을 임명했다. 충북 보은 출신인 최 신임 청장은 한국외국어대를 나와 소방간부 10기로 입직해 전남소방본부장, 경기도 소방재난본부 전담직무대리 등을 맡았다. 청와대 국가안보실 국가위기관리센터에 파견 근무한 이력도 있다.)

Senior Secretary Kang said, "Commissioner Choi is a fire service expert who has spent 27 years across both frontline rescue operations and key policy departments," adding, "He possesses outstanding on-site command skills, strong execution ability, and rich administrative experience, and enjoys high trust within the National Fire Agency for his rational leadership that emphasizes communication and harmony." (강 수석대변인은 “최 청장은 27년 동안 일선 구조 현장과 핵심 정책 부서를 모두 거친 소방 전문가”라며 “탁월한 현장 지휘 능력과 업무 추진력, 풍부한 행정 경험을 겸비했으며, 소통과 화합의 합리적 리더십으로 소방청 내에서 신망도 높다”고 했다.)

Previously, former Commissioner Kim Seung-ryong stepped down in June, just three months after taking office. At the time, the presidential office launched an inspection into Commissioner Kim, and allegations emerged that he had taken a trip abroad for leisure purposes. However, the presidential office did not disclose the specific reasons for the inspection. (앞서 전임 김승룡 소방청장은 지난 6월 취임 3개월 만에 물러났다. 당시 청와대가 김 청장에 대한 감찰에 착수했고, 김 청장이 외유성 해외 출장을 다녀왔다는 등의 의혹이 흘러나왔다. 하지만 청와대는 구체적인 감찰 사유는 밝히지 않았다.)

item.title: US Ambassador Steel's Fine-Print Correction: "National Assembly Library Books Were Lent, Not Donated" (“국회도서관 책, 기증 아니라 대여” 깨알 지적한 스틸 美대사)
item.description:
US Ambassador Steel's Fine-Print Correction: "National Assembly Library Books Were Lent, Not Donated" (“국회도서관 책, 기증 아니라 대여” 깨알 지적한 스틸 美대사)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik met with U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel on the 21st and said, "I deeply empathize with and highly appreciate President Trump's will and determination to break the ice for dialogue on the chilled Korean Peninsula and to establish a stable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula." (조정식 국회의장은 21일 미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사를 만나 “냉각돼 있는 한반도에 대화의 물꼬를 트고 한반도의 안정적 평화 체제를 구축하기 위한 트럼프 대통령의 의지와 결단에 깊이 공감하며 이를 높이 평가한다”고 했다.)

During the meeting with Ambassador Steel at the National Assembly that day, Speaker Woo said, "This year marks the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States and the 73rd anniversary of the Korea-U.S. alliance. I hope that the friendship and cooperation between our two countries, which have together upheld the values of freedom and democracy, will grow even stronger in the future." (조 의장은 이날 국회에서 스틸 대사를 접견한 자리에서 “올해는 미국 건국 250주년이자 한미동맹 73주년이 되는 해다. 그동안 자유와 민주주의 가치를 함께 지켜온 양국의 우정과 협력이 앞으로 더욱 굳건해지기를 바란다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Regarding Ambassador Steel, who is of Korean descent, Speaker Woo said, "She has demonstrated extensive experience and capability in U.S. politics, including as a federal congresswoman, and because she has a deep understanding of and affection for Korea, I expect she will be a great asset to the development of Korea-U.S. relations." (조 의장은 한국계인 스틸 대사에 대해 “연방 하원의원 등 미국 정계에서 많은 경륜과 역량을 발휘해왔고, 한국에 대해서 깊은 이해와 애정을 갖고 있기 때문에 앞으로 한미관계 발전에 큰 힘이 될 거라고 기대한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo, who previously served as co-chair of the National Assembly's Korea-U.S. Parliamentary Friendship Association, said, "It would be great if the U.S. Congress had a group like the 'U.S.-Korea Parliamentary Friendship Association,' but there is no proper counterpart right now. I think it would be of even greater help to bilateral relations if one were established in the future." (국회 한미의원연맹 공동 회장을 맡았던 조 의장은 “미국 의회에도 ‘미한의원연맹’ 같은 그룹이 있으면 좋겠는데 마땅한 카운터파트가 없는 상황”이라며 “앞으로 생기면 양국 관계에 더 큰 도움이 될 거라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo said, "The National Assembly of the Republic of Korea has a very important legacy symbolizing Korea-U.S. friendship. During the Korean War in 1951, the U.S. Embassy donated 700 books to the refugee National Assembly. That became a crucial starting point for our current National Assembly Library." He added, "Seventy-five years later, our National Assembly Library has grown into a library with the largest collection of public materials in the country. So today, with a grateful heart, I have prepared a plaque of appreciation for the U.S. Embassy." (조 의장은 “대한민국 국회에는 한미 우호를 상징하는 아주 중요한 유산이 있다”며 “1951년 6·25전쟁 당시에 미국 대사관이 피란 국회에 책 700권을 기증했었다. 이것이 현재 우리 국회도서관이 출발하는 중요한 계기가 됐다”고 했다. 이어 “그 후로 75년이 지나서 지금 우리 국회도서관은 국내 최대 규모의 공공자료를 갖춘 도서관으로 성장했다. 그래서 오늘 고마운 마음을 담아서 미 대사관에 감사패를 준비했다”고 했다.)

In response, Ambassador Steel said, "You said the 700 books were 'donated,' but as far as I know, they were 'lent.' I understand that we got them back." This drew laughter from Speaker Woo and the other attendees. Ambassador Steel added, "I am also very pleased that this served as the foundation for the National Assembly Library's beginnings." (스틸 대사는 이에 대해 “책 700권을 ‘기증’했다고 했는데, 제가 알기로는 ‘대여’를 한 걸로 알고 있다”며 “저희가 다시 돌려받는 것으로 이해하고 있다”고 했다. 이에 조 의장을 비롯한 참석자들이 웃음을 터뜨리기도 했다. 스틸 대사는 “이를 바탕으로 국회도서관이 출발하는 계기가 됐다고 해서 저도 굉장히 기쁘게 생각한다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Steel said, "Because I have experience working in Congress, I understand firsthand how important a role (the legislature) plays in shaping foreign policy and international relations. Above all, since our two countries' alliance has a long-standing tradition of 73 years, I believe that is what matters most." (스틸 대사는 “제가 의회에서 일한 경험이 있기 때문에 외교 정책과 국제 관계를 형성하는 데 있어 (국회가) 얼마나 중요한 역할을 하는지 온몸으로 이해하고 있다”며 “무엇보다 양국 동맹이 73년이라는 오랜 유구한 전통을 갖고 있기 때문에 이것이 가장 중요하다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

She said, "I hope that my experience as a lawmaker will serve as an opportunity to deepen bilateral relations, support each other, and gain a deeper mutual understanding of how the National Assembly and the U.S. Congress operate. I look forward to working closely with Speaker Woo." (그는 “의원으로서 일한 경험이 양국의 관계를 보다 심화시키고 서로 뒷받침할 뿐 아니라 어떻게 국회와 미국 의회가 작동하는지 서로 깊이 이해할 수 있는 계기가 되길 바란다”며 “조 의장과 함께 긴밀하게 협력하기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

Regarding Speaker Woo's proposal for a 'U.S.-Korea Parliamentary Friendship Association,' Ambassador Steel also said, "Above all, I believe communication is the most important element, whether at the level of lawmakers or the U.S. Congress. If I can be of help, I would like to actively assist." (스틸 대사는 조 의장이 제안한 ‘미한의원연맹’과 관련해서도 “무엇보다 의원들이나 미국 의회 차원에서도 소통이 무엇보다 가장 중요한 요소라 생각한다”며 “제가 일조할 수 있다면 적극적으로 도움을 드리고 싶다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party lawmakers oppose Jang Dong-hyuk's 're-election of all district committee chairs' plan... Will Jang push it through? (국힘 의원들 “장동혁 ‘당협 전원 재선출 案’ 반대”…張, 강행하나)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmakers oppose Jang Dong-hyuk's 're-election of all district committee chairs' plan... Will Jang push it through? (국힘 의원들 “장동혁 ‘당협 전원 재선출 案’ 반대”…張, 강행하나)

At a general assembly of lawmakers on the 21st, the People Power Party gathered opposition to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's push for 're-election of all district party committee chairs.' Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik decided to convey the outcome of the general assembly to the Supreme Council meeting scheduled for next week. (국민의힘은 21일 의원총회에서 장동혁 대표가 추진하는 ‘당협위원장 전원 재선출’에 대해 반대한다는 뜻을 모았다. 정점식 원내대표는 이 같은 의원총회 결과를 다음 주 열릴 최고위원 회의에서 전달하기로 했다.)

Earlier, at the Supreme Council meeting the previous day, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk had attempted to pass an agenda item to collectively dismiss all district party committee chairs across the 254 National Assembly constituencies nationwide and then re-elect them through party member voting, but he postponed it after lawmakers within the party pushed back. (앞서 장동혁 대표는 전날 최고위원 회의에서 전국 국회의원 지역구 254곳에 있는 당협위원장 전원을 일괄 사퇴시킨 뒤 당원 투표로 재선출하는 안건을 통과시키려 했으나, 당내 의원들이 반발하자 보류하기로 했다.)

Among non-pro-power lawmakers, there was resistance, with remarks such as "Isn't Representative Jang effectively trying to exercise the nomination rights for the 2028 general election in advance?" and "If district committee chairs are elected by party member voting, it will move further away from public sentiment and make victory in the general election more difficult." (비당권파 의원들 사이에서는 “장 대표가 사실상 2028년 총선 공천권을 미리 행사하겠다는 시도 아니냐” “당원 투표로 당협위원장을 선출하면 민심과 더 멀어져 총선 승리가 더 어려워진다”는 반발이 나왔다.)

Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choi Su-jin said in a briefing immediately after the general assembly that day, "To get straight to the conclusion, the view is that we should proceed as before—that is, re-electing (district committee chairs) through the district party council's steering committee," and added, "Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik will convey this content to the Supreme Council." (최수진 원내수석대변인은 이날 의원총회 직후 브리핑에서 “결론부터 말하면 기존 방식대로 하는 것, 즉 당원협의회 운영위원회에서 (당협위원장을) 재선출하는 방식이 좋겠다는 것”이라며 “정점식 원내대표가 이 내용을 최고위에 전달할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Choi conveyed Floor Leader Jeong's remarks, saying, "The intent of choosing district committee chairs through party member selection is good, but right now the party is becoming too chaotic, and if we vote in this manner, party members could become divided. Now is the time to fight the Democratic Party and pursue internal unity." (최 대변인은 “당원의 선택을 통해서 당협위원장을 뽑자는 취지는 좋지만, 지금은 당이 너무 혼란스러워지고, 이런 식으로 투표하게 되면 당원들이 갈라질 수 있다”며 “지금은 민주당과 싸워야 하고 당내 통합을 해야 할 타이밍”이라고 정 원내대표가 말했다고 전했다.)

She continued, "Since re-electing (district committee chairs) through the steering committee is also a provision in the party constitution and rules, we think it is best to simply follow established practice," and added, "We plan to convey this position to the Supreme Council." (이어 “운영위원회를 통해서 (당협위원장을) 재선출하는 방식 또한 당헌·당규에 있는 규정이므로 우리는 그냥 관행대로 가는 것이 좋겠다는 것”이라며 “이 뜻을 최고위원회에 전달할 예정”이라고 했다.)

Representative Jang did not attend the general assembly that day, citing a health checkup. (장 대표는 이날 의원총회에 건강검진을 이유로 불참했다.)

The district party committee chair is the person responsible for managing a constituency and is considered a leading candidate in nominations for the next general election. Typically, if the party has an incumbent lawmaker in that constituency, they concurrently serve as the district committee chair; if there is no incumbent, the chair is appointed through an open application process among outside figures seeking to run in the general election. However, Representative Jang, championing the 'party member-centered party' line, has come forward to restart the selection of all district committee chairs, both incumbent and non-incumbent, from scratch. (당협위원장은 지역구를 맡아 관리하는 책임자로, 다음 총선 공천에서 유력한 주자로 꼽힌다. 통상 해당 지역구에 자당 현역 의원이 있으면 그가 당협위원장을 겸임하고, 현역 의원이 없으면 총선 출마를 노리는 원외 인사들의 공모를 거쳐 당협위원장으로 임명한다. 그런데 장 대표가 ‘당원 중심 정당’ 노선을 앞세우면서 원내·원외 당협위원장 전원을 원점에서 다시 뽑겠다고 나선 것이다.)

Representative Jang plans to revisit the 'replacement of all district committee chairs' agenda item at the party's Supreme Council meeting on the 24th. (장 대표는 오는 24일 당 최고위원 회의에서 ‘당협위원장 전원 교체’ 안건을 다시 논의할 예정이다.)

item.title: Is Ha-young's Great-Grandfather's Land 'Pro-Japanese Property'? Cho Kuk Party's Park Eun-jung Says "It Must Be Confiscated," Justice Deputy Minister Says "We Will Keep a Close Eye on It" (하영 증조부 땅은 ‘친일 재산’? 조국당 박은정 “환수해야” 법무차관 “잘 챙겨 보겠다”)
item.description:
Is Ha-young's Great-Grandfather's Land 'Pro-Japanese Property'? Cho Kuk Party's Park Eun-jung Says "It Must Be Confiscated," Justice Deputy Minister Says "We Will Keep a Close Eye on It" (하영 증조부 땅은 ‘친일 재산’? 조국당 박은정 “환수해야” 법무차관 “잘 챙겨 보겠다”)

A claim was made in the National Assembly that the state should confiscate the property of the family of actress Ha-young (real name Ahn Ha-young), amid controversy that her great-grandfather collaborated with the Japanese colonial authorities. (증조부가 일제에 부역했다는 논란이 인 배우 하영(본명 안하영)씨 가족의 재산을 국가가 환수해야 한다는 주장이 국회에서 나왔다.)

At a plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 21st, Rep. Park Eun-jung of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party cited media reports that Ha-young's great-grandfather, Ahn Sang-ho, was confirmed to have owned about 2,700 pyeong (approximately 8,900 square meters) of land in the Gunpo, Gyeonggi Province area during the Japanese colonial period, stating, "Ahn was a large landowner who accumulated wealth during the Japanese colonial era, and that property appears to have been pro-Japanese property." According to a report by Weekly Kyunghyang, the land register from the Japanese colonial period shows Ahn holding about 2,700 pyeong of land at 235 Geumjeong-ri, Nammyeon, Siheung-gun (now Siheung-si). The land was expropriated by the state in 1983, but it has not been confirmed whether Ahn's descendants continued to hold the land until 1983 and thus received compensation. <<> The controversy over Ha-young's ancestor's collaboration with Japan began when Ha-young said on a broadcast on the 7th that her family had been doctors for four generations starting with her great-grandfather, stating, "My great-grandfather studied Western medicine in Japan and was the first doctor to open a practice in Korea. He even treated Emperor Gojong." As this great-grandfather was revealed to be Ahn, online communities began a so-called "online grave excavation" reexamining Ahn's activities. This was because it was confirmed that Ahn had been a council member—an executive position—of the Daejeong Friendship Society (Daejeong chinmokhoe), an organization that in 1916 led the Japanese policy of "Ilseon Yunghwa" (merging Japan and Korea into one). <<> It has not been confirmed whether there is a direct connection between Ahn's land in Siheung and the property of Ha-young's family. Rep. Park also said, "It is not certain whether it falls under the target of (confiscation under) the Pro-Japanese Property Confiscation Act." She added, "Ahn is not included in the official list of pro-Japanese collaborators published by the Institute for Ethnic Culture or the Truth Commission on Pro-Japanese Collaborators' Anti-National Acts." <<> Nevertheless, Rep. Park said, "(Ahn) was not a traitor, nor a member of the Japanese parliament, nor did he receive a noble title, but the (Property Investigation) Committee could determine that Ahn was an anti-national actor and that his property was pro-Japanese property." <<> In response, Deputy Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo said, "The preparatory team for the establishment of the Pro-Japanese Property Investigation Committee is carrying out practical work for its launch in December," and "The committee will work diligently to confiscate pro-Japanese property through various activities beyond existing data." He added, "We will also make sure the committee is smoothly formed and launched properly." <<> The committee, to be established under the Pro-Japanese Property Confiscation Act, which takes effect on December 3, will have the authority to designate pro-Japanese anti-national actors and determine their property as "pro-Japanese property." Property determined to be pro-Japanese becomes state-owned. However, if a third party acquired the property without knowing it was pro-Japanese, or acquired it by paying a legitimate price, the state cannot take it. The committee operated once from 2006 to 2010, confiscating 2,359 parcels of land worth 237.3 billion won at the then-market value. Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho, while preparing for the launch of the second committee, said, "We expect to confiscate at least 32.5 billion won or more in pro-Japanese property." <<> The following is the full text of the Q&A between Rep. Park and Deputy Minister Lee. <<> Rep. Park Eun-jung of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party: Recently, ahead of Liberation Day, the pro-Japanese activities of a celebrity's great-grandfather became an issue. As we mark the 81st anniversary of liberation, public interest in settling pro-Japanese legacies is high. According to today's report on this celebrity's great-grandfather—whose name has now been specifically identified—2,700 pyeong of land in Gunpo was found in land records from the 1910s. This pro-Japanese family appears to have been large landowners holding vast tracts of land around Anyang Station and Gunpo Station. So, the great-grandfather did not accumulate this wealth later as a doctor, but was already a large landowner who had accumulated property during the Japanese colonial period—it appears to have been pro-Japanese property. Coincidentally, the amendment to the Special Act on the State Confiscation of Property of Pro-Japanese Anti-National Actors, which passed the National Assembly in May and which you, Deputy Minister, reported on, takes effect on December 3, and you said a (Property Investigation) Committee would be formed. That's the first time in 16 years. <<> Deputy Minister Lee Jin-soo: That's correct. <<> Rep. Park: Now, regarding this celebrity's great-grandfather, it is not yet certain whether this falls under pro-Japanese property, but in my view, although the celebrity's great-grandfather is not included in the official list (of pro-Japanese anti-national actors) published by the Institute for Ethnic Culture or the past Truth Commission, this committee could make a determination. That is, he was not a traitor, nor a member of the Japanese parliament, nor did he receive a noble title, nor was he a councilor of the Central Advisory Institute, but under the committee's other determination provisions, this could be judged as pro-Japanese property and him as an anti-national actor. According to a paper published in 2007 by a senior research fellow at the Institute for Historical Studies, this great-grandfather was listed in 1916 as a council member—an executive position—of the Daejeong Friendship Society, which the Japanese Government-General's Police Bureau defined as an organization whose purpose was to endorse governor-general rule and promote the merger of Japan and Korea (naeseon yunghwa). <<> Under the Pro-Japanese Property Confiscation Act and the Special Act I mentioned earlier (the Special Act on the Truth Investigation of Anti-National Acts Under Japanese Colonial Rule), it seems possible to determine whether someone can be designated as a pro-Japanese anti-national actor by comprehensively reviewing the nature of their organizational activities, their leading role, the degree of involvement in naeseon yunghwa, and whether there was compensation for collaborating with colonial rule. <<> Therefore, even if someone was omitted from past lists, I believe the Ministry of Justice must respond to the public's anger—the anger that descendants have unjustly inherited such pro-Japanese property, accumulated wealth, and that three generations of pro-Japanese collaborators are living lavishly—by ensuring the state confiscates all such pro-Japanese property without exception. I hope you, Deputy Minister, will take an interest in and oversee the committee launching in December. I'd like your response. <<> Deputy Minister Lee: Yes, the preparatory team has been formed and is carrying out practical work for the December launch. As the Minister explained, the minimum expected confiscation amount is 32.5 billion won, but that figure is based on the information we currently have without investigative authority. Once the committee is launched, it will operate for up to five years. We expect the committee to act with independence and work diligently to confiscate pro-Japanese property through various activities beyond existing data. We will also make sure the committee is smoothly formed and launched properly. (박은정 조국혁신당 의원은 21일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의에서 하영의 증조부 안상호씨가 일제강점기에 경기 군포시 일대에 2700평(약 8900㎡) 땅을 갖고 있었던 것이 확인됐다는 언론 보도를 인용하면서 “안씨가 일제강점기에 재산을 축적한 대지주였고, 그 재산은 친일 재산이었던 것으로 보인다”고 했다. 주간경향 보도에 따르면, 일제강점기 토지조사부에는 안씨가 시흥군(현 시흥시) 남면 금정리 235번지에 땅 2700평을 갖고 있는 것으로 나온다. 이 땅은 1983년에 국가에 수용됐으나, 안씨 후손이 그 땅을 1983년까지 계속 갖고 있었는지, 그래서 보상금을 받아갔는지는 확인되지 않았다.)

item.title: Lee: "Sorry, Senior Noh Woong-rae"... Apology over exclusion from candidacy after acquittal in appellate court (李 “노웅래 선배님 죄송합니다”... 2심 무죄에 공천 배제 사과)
item.description:
Lee: "Sorry, Senior Noh Woong-rae"... Apology over exclusion from candidacy after acquittal in appellate court (李 “노웅래 선배님 죄송합니다”... 2심 무죄에 공천 배제 사과)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 21st that he "offers words of congratulations along with a belated apology" regarding former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae, who was indicted on charges of bribery and illegal political funds but was acquitted in both the first and second trials. This was an apology for having excluded Noh from candidacy in the general election based on his indictment by prosecutors while Lee served as party leader. (이재명 대통령은 21일 뇌물 및 불법 정치자금 수수 혐의로 기소된 노웅래 전 더불어민주당 의원이 1·2심에서 무죄 선고를 받은 것에 대해 “축하 말씀과 함께, 뒤늦은 사죄 말씀을 드린다”고 밝혔다. 자신이 민주당 대표 시절 검찰 기소를 이유로 노 전 의원을 총선에서 공천 배제한 사실에 대해 사과한 것이다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day, President Lee said, "The general election held in 2024 was one that had to be won even at the risk of death, so as the person leading the Democratic Party, I had no choice but to hold back tears and exclude former lawmaker Noh from candidacy." (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에서 “2024년에 치러진 총선은 죽음을 무릅쓰고라도 반드시 이겨야 하는 선거였기 때문에, 민주당을 지휘하던 저는 눈물을 머금고 노 전 의원님을 공천 배제할 수밖에 없었다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

President Lee added, "Former lawmaker Noh is a senior from university whom I personally respect and one of my few political allies, and for the Democratic Party, he was the candidate with the highest chance of winning in Seoul's Mapo Gap district. However, he became the prey of the tenacious political prosecutors and was ultimately branded a corruption criminal and indicted." (이 대통령은 “노 전 의원님은 개인적으로 존경하는 대학 선배님이시자 몇 안 되는 정치적 조력자였으며, 민주당으로서는 서울 마포갑 지역에서 당선 가능성이 가장 높은 후보였다”며 “그러나 집요한 정치검찰의 먹이가 되어 결국 부정부패사범으로 몰려 기소되었다”고 했다.)

He then referenced the fact that he had cut off former lawmaker Noh from candidacy in the 2024 general election while serving as party leader, saying, "How could anyone who is not the person involved even begin to imagine how wronged Senior Noh must have felt, having been indicted by political prosecutors and stripped of his political life by the party?" (이어 자신이 당 대표 시절 2024년 총선 공천에서 노 전 의원을 컷오프했던 사실을 거론하며 “정치 검찰에 의해 기소되고 당에 의해 정치 생명까지 박탈당한 노 선배님께서 얼마나 억울했을지 당사자가 아닌 한 어떻게 짐작이나 할 수 있겠느냐”고 했다.)

At the time, the Democratic Party cut off incumbent five-term lawmaker Noh in Mapo Gap and strategically nominated former senior superintendent Lee Ji-eun instead. In response, former lawmaker Noh occupied the party leader's conference room and staged a hunger strike. At the time, President Lee remained firm, saying, "Doing this won't change the situation" and "The issue of receiving money is a fact, so the party has no choice but to deal with it strictly." During Noh's nine-day hunger strike, Lee presided over meetings at the party headquarters in Yeouido. (당시 민주당은 마포갑에서 5선을 지낸 현역 노 전 의원을 컷오프하고, 이지은 전 총경을 전략공천했다. 이에 노 전 의원은 민주당 당 대표 회의실을 점거해 단식 농성을 벌였고, 당시 이 대통령은 “이런다고 해서 상황이 바뀌지는 않는다” “금품 수수 문제는 사실이니 당이 엄정하게 갈 수밖다”며 단호한 모습을 보였다. 노 전 의원이 9일 간의 단식 농성을 하는 동안, 이 대통령은 여의도 당사에서 회의를 주재했었다.)

President Lee said, "As party leader, for the sake of the overall election and yielding to the vicious acts of political prosecutors, I had no choice but to execute my own general. With pain and regret, I now offer my congratulations and belated apology to Senior Noh, who has at least proven his innocence and escaped the danger of imprisonment." He added, "Senior Noh Woong-rae, I'm sorry. I respect you. I love you." (이 대통령은 “당대표로서 전체 선거를 위해 정치 검찰의 패악질에 편승하여 읍참마속할 수 밖에 없었던 저는 아픔과 회한 속에 그나마 무고함을 증명받고 영어의 위험을 벗어난 노 선배님께 축하 말씀과 함께 뒤늦은 사죄 말씀을 드린다”며 “노웅래 선배님, 죄송합니다. 존경합니다. 사랑합니다”라고 했다.)

Earlier, the 5-2 Criminal Appellate Division of the Seoul Central District Court upheld the lower court's ruling of acquittal on the charge of violating the Political Funds Act against former lawmaker Noh. The appellate court, like the first trial, ruled that the evidence in this case, obtained during the seizure and search of the mobile phone of Cho, the spouse of businessman Park, constituted "illegally obtained evidence" and therefore lacked admissibility. (앞서 서울중앙지법 형사항소5-2부는 노 전 의원에 대한 정치자금법 위반 혐의를 무죄 선고한 원심 판단을 유지했다. 재판부는 1심과 마찬가지로 사업가 박모씨 배우자 조모씨의 휴대전화를 압수수색을 하는 과정에서 확보된 이 사건 단서가 ‘위법수집증거’이므로 증거능력이 없다고 판단했다.)

item.title: Park Jeong-seong Appointed as Trade Minister for Trade Negotiations, Choi Yong-cheol as National Fire Agency Commissioner (박정성 통상교섭본부장, 최용철 소방청장 임명)
item.description:
Park Jeong-seong Appointed as Trade Minister for Trade Negotiations, Choi Yong-cheol as National Fire Agency Commissioner (박정성 통상교섭본부장, 최용철 소방청장 임명)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 21st appointed Park Jeong-seong, Deputy Minister for Trade at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, as the Trade Minister for Trade Negotiations at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. The new minister, a native of Daegu, is a graduate of the 40th Higher Civil Service Examination and has consistently handled trade-related affairs at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, serving as Director-General for Trade Policy and Director-General for Trade and Investment. He will take over trade negotiations with the United States and other matters in place of former Minister Yeo Han-gu, who was dismissed last week. (이재명 대통령은 21일 산업통상부 통상교섭본부장에 박정성 산업통상부 통상차관보를 임명했다. 대구 출신인 박 신임 본부장은 행정고시 40회 출신으로 줄곧 산업통상부에서 무역정책관과 무역투자실장 등 통상 관련 업무를 해왔다. 지난주 면직 조치된 여한구 전 본부장을 대신해 미국과 통상 협상 등을 맡게 됐다.)

Choi Yong-cheol, Deputy Commissioner of the National Fire Agency, has been appointed as the new Commissioner of the National Fire Agency. The new commissioner, a native of Boeun County, North Chungcheong Province, entered the service through the 10th class of fire service executives and has served as head of the South Jeolla Province Fire Headquarters and acting head of the Gyeonggi Province Fire and Disaster Prevention Headquarters. The position of Fire Agency Commissioner had been vacant since former Commissioner Kim Seung-ryong stepped down in June after facing an inspection by the presidential office. (신임 소방청장에는 최용철 소방청 차장이 임명됐다. 최 신임 청장은 충북 보은 출신으로 소방간부 10기로 입직해 전남소방본부장, 경기도 소방재난본부장 전담직무대리 등을 지냈다. 소방청장은 지난 6월 김승룡 전 청장이 청와대 감찰을 받은 뒤 물러나 공석이었다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Jang Dong-hyeok to Hold First Meeting on the 24th (김민석·장동혁 24일 첫 회동)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Jang Dong-hyeok to Hold First Meeting on the 24th (김민석·장동혁 24일 첫 회동)

Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok and People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyeok will meet at the National Assembly on the 24th. It will be the first time the two party leaders meet outside of a presidential-hosted luncheon or a national commemorative event since September 1, 2024, when then-Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung and then-People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon sat down together—two years ago. (더불어민주당 김민석, 국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 오는 24일 국회에서 만난다. 양당 대표가 대통령 주재 오찬이나 국가 기념 행사 자리 외의 장소에서 만나는 것은 2024년 9월 1일 이재명 당시 민주당 대표와 한동훈 당시 국민의힘 대표의 회동 이후 2년 만이다.)

A key Democratic Party official told this newspaper in a phone call on the 21st, "This meeting is a courtesy introduction in light of Representative Kim's inauguration." An aide to Representative Jang also said, "I understand that Representative Kim's side reached out first to propose the meeting." (민주당 핵심 관계자는 21일 본지 통화에서 “이번 만남은 김 대표의 취임에 따른 상견례 성격의 자리”라고 했다. 장 대표 측 관계자도 “김 대표 측에서 먼저 만나자고 연락이 온 것으로 안다”고 했다.)

The two leaders are expected to exchange views on major pending issues such as the government's real estate policies. Since Representative Kim has emphasized party-government alignment and cross-party cooperation since the party leadership race, the future operation of the National Assembly and handling of livelihood-related bills may also be on the table. (양 대표는 정부의 부동산 정책 등 주요 현안에 대해 의견을 나눌 것으로 보인다. 김 대표가 전당대회 경선 때부터 당정 일치와 여야 협치를 강조해온 만큼, 앞으로의 국회 운영과 민생 법안 처리 문제도 테이블에 오를 가능성이 있다.)

It is customary for a newly inaugurated parliamentary party leader to visit and meet with leaders of other parliamentary parties. However, after the December 3 martial law declaration, relations between the Democratic Party and the People Power Party deteriorated further, and with the Democratic Party transitioning to a leadership under Representative Jung Cheong-rae, bilateral meetings between the two party leaders were not held over the past two years. Upon taking office in August last year, former Representative Jung directed his remarks at the People Power Party, saying, "I will not shake hands unless there is an apology and reflection over the December 3 martial law insurrection," and refused to meet with the People Power Party leadership. He also appeared on the Kim Eo-jun YouTube channel and quipped, "A handshake is something you do with a person." He did, however, pay courtesy visits to the leaders of other parliamentary parties, such as the Rebuilding Korea Party and the Progressive Party. (원내 정당 대표가 취임하면 다른 원내 정당 대표들을 찾아가 만나는 것이 관례다. 그러나 12·3 비상 계엄 이후 민주당과 국민의힘 관계가 한층 악화하고 민주당이 정청래 대표 체제로 바뀌면서 양당 대표 간 양자 회동은 지난 2년간 이뤄지지 못했다. 정 전 대표는 지난해 8월 취임하자마자 국민의힘을 겨냥해 “12·3 비상 계엄 내란에 대한 사과와 반성이 없으면 악수하지 않겠다”며 국민의힘 지도부와 만나지 않았다. 김어준 유튜브에 출연해 “악수도 사람하고 하는 것”이라고 말하기도 했다. 조국혁신당, 진보당 등 다른 원내 정당 대표들에게는 인사를 갔다.)

Former Representative Jung and Representative Jang did meet on September 8 last year when President Lee Jae-myung invited the ruling and opposition party leaders to a luncheon at the Yongsan presidential office. Under President Lee's mediation, Jung and Jang shook hands, and the three joined hands together for a commemorative photo. Jang quipped, "I started eating garlic and mugwort the moment I became party leader just to shake hands with Representative Jung," adding, "It hasn't even been 100 days, but I'm grateful that you've agreed to this handshake today." The two leaders met again in April this year when President Lee hosted a ruling-opposition-government livelihood economy consultative meeting and luncheon at Cheong Wa Dae, where the president said, "You two aren't still refusing to shake hands, are you? Try practicing once," and brought their hands together himself. (정 전 대표와 장 대표는 지난해 9월 8일 이재명 대통령이 용산 대통령실에 여야 대표를 불러 오찬 회동을 하면서 만난 적은 있다. 이 대통령의 중재로 정 전 대표와 장 대표가 악수했고, 셋이 함께 손을 잡고 기념사진도 찍었다. 장 대표는 “정 대표와 악수하려고 당대표가 되자마자 마늘하고 쑥을 먹기 시작했다”며 “미처 100일이 안 됐는데, 오늘 이렇게 악수에 응해 주셔서 감사드린다”고 비꼬았다. 양 대표는 지난 4월 이 대통령이 청와대에서 여야정 민생 경제 협의체 회담과 오찬을 주재한 자리에서 다시 만났고, 이때는 이 대통령이 “두 분 요즘도 손 안 잡고 그러는 것 아니냐. 연습 한번 해보라”며 양 대표의 손을 가져다 맞잡게 했다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party's new leadership will hold a dinner meeting with President Lee Jae-myung on the 25th. Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung of Cheong Wa Dae said, "The President plans to invite the new leadership to Cheong Wa Dae on the 25th for a dinner," adding, "Representative Kim, floor leader Han Byeong-do, Supreme Council members, and key party officials will attend." (이런 가운데, 민주당 새 지도부는 25일에는 이재명 대통령과 만찬 회동을 한다. 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 25일 신임 지도부를 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 함께할 예정”이라며 “김 대표와 한병도 원내대표, 최고위원들과 주요 당직자들이 참석한다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Ruling party lawmakers oppose party district chair replacement at caucus... silent on disciplinary action against four (국힘 의총서 당협위원장 교체에 반대… 4인 징계엔 침묵)
item.description:
Ruling party lawmakers oppose party district chair replacement at caucus... silent on disciplinary action against four (국힘 의총서 당협위원장 교체에 반대… 4인 징계엔 침묵)

People Power Party lawmakers held a caucus meeting at the National Assembly on the 21st and agreed to oppose the party district committee chair selection plan being pushed by leader Jang Dong-hyuk. Party district committee chairs have previously been selected by district operating committees, but Jang is calling for all party district committee chairs—including those districts where incumbent lawmakers currently serve as chairs—to be elected by party member vote. If implemented, this would reduce lawmakers' influence and potentially amplify the voices of prospective candidates and hardline party members. Concerns and backlash also continued inside and outside the party over the party ethics committee's decision the previous day to suspend the party membership rights of lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-soo, and Jin Jong-oh for periods ranging from 10 months to 2 years and 6 months. <<> Around 60 of the 109 People Power Party lawmakers attended the caucus that day. Lawmakers said Jang's plan to select party district committee chairs would "only amplify conflict among party members." Floor leader Chung Jin-suk reportedly shared an anecdote at the caucus about visiting flood-damaged areas in Tongyeong, South Gyeongsang Province with Jang three days earlier, where they were verbally abused by a hardline party member, saying, "The party is already this divided—if we elect district committee chairs by party member vote, the division will only get worse." <<> Lawmakers Kim Tae-ho and Yoon Han-hong reportedly also spoke in turn, saying, "At a time when we should focus on the fight against the opposition, we must not destabilize local party organizations over the district committee chair selection issue." One attendee said, "The prevailing opinion was that now is the time to rebuild local organizations damaged by the June 3 local election defeat. If the party destabilizes local organizations, I don't know how we're supposed to fight the 2028 general election." After the caucus ended, chief deputy floor spokesperson Choi Su-jin told reporters, "(The caucus conclusion) is to maintain the existing method," and said the opinion would be conveyed to the supreme council. <<> The People Power Party leadership discussed at its supreme council meeting on the 20th a plan to elect by party member vote all 254 district committee chairs nationwide whose terms (2 years) end this month. Jang has repeatedly emphasized the fight against the opposition, saying, "Only 20% of lawmakers are fighting—I want to create a party where 80% fight," and has signaled his intention to restructure the party around party members. However, senior lawmakers and non-mainstream faction members called it "an attempt to replace chairs with pro-Jang Dong-hyuk figures ahead of the next general election." <<> Although lawmakers oppose Jang's plan, the method of selecting district committee chairs does not require a party rule revision or caucus approval, so Jang may push through his position at next week's supreme council meeting. An aide to Jang said, "In the end, aren't incumbent lawmakers opposing the party member vote for district chairs because they fear their positions are threatened? I think Jang's original proposal is highly likely to pass at next week's supreme council." Jang did not attend the caucus that day, citing a hospital checkup. <<> Initially, there were expectations that the caucus that day would discuss the disciplinary measures the party ethics committee had imposed on four incumbent lawmakers the previous day. However, reportedly no significant remarks were made even in the closed session. Non-mainstream lawmakers, including those aligned with former leader Han Dong-hoon, either skipped the caucus or refrained from speaking. <<> One second-term lawmaker said, "The severity of the discipline seems high, but the reasons don't allow unconditional defense, so most lawmakers seem to just be watching." An opposition party official said, "The district chair issue is lawmakers' own problem, but disciplining lawmakers is someone else's problem." <<> Lawmaker Jin Jong-oh, who received a 2-year suspension of party membership rights, held a press conference that day and said, "Don't turn the ethics committee into a tool of political retaliation." Jin was disciplined for reasons including helping independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon in the June 3 by-elections. He is reportedly also considering filing a court injunction to suspend the disciplinary effect. Kwon Young-jin, who received a 1-year-6-month suspension for grabbing Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk by the collar over dissatisfaction with committee assignments, said on CBS Radio, "I will dedicate myself to building a winning conservatism, not the petty conservatism of Jang Dong-hyuk." <<> Lawmakers Na Kyung-won, Yoon Sang-hyun, and Kim Tae-ho expressed concerns about the discipline via Facebook and other channels, while the lawmakers' group "Alternatives and Future," to which Seo Beom-soo and Jin Jong-oh belong, distributed a statement saying, "Heavy discipline that ends political careers will drive the party into a vortex of division." Supreme council member Kim Jae-won said on SBS Radio, "Excessive discipline is not desirable." Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, targeting Jang on Facebook, said, "This is disciplinary politics for personal glorification—it's helping the crisis-stricken Lee Jae-myung Democratic Party administration." (국민의힘 의원들이 21일 국회에서 의원총회를 열고 장동혁 대표가 추진 중인 당협위원장 선출안에 반대하기로 의견을 모았다. 당협위원장은 그간 당협 운영위원회에서 뽑았는데, 장 대표는 현역 의원이 당협위원장인 지역을 포함해 모든 당협위원장을 당원 투표로 선출하자는 입장이다. 이렇게 되면 국회의원의 영향력이 줄어들고 출마 예정자나 강성 당원의 목소리가 커질 가능성이 있다. 당 안팎에선 전날 당 윤리위원회가 조경태·권영진·서범수·진종오 의원에게 10개월에서 2년 6개월의 당원권 정지를 결정한 데 대한 우려와 반발도 이어졌다.)

item.title: President Lee Said to Move into Cheong Wa Dae Residence in First Half... But Move-in Date Still Not Set (상반기에 靑 입주한다더니… 이삿날 못잡는 李대통령)
item.description:
President Lee Said to Move into Cheong Wa Dae Residence in First Half... But Move-in Date Still Not Set (상반기에 靑 입주한다더니… 이삿날 못잡는 李대통령)

President Lee Jae-myung has been commuting to Cheong Wa Dae from the official residence in Hannam-dong, Yongsan, Seoul, for nearly 1 year and 3 months since taking office in June last year. When Cheong Wa Dae officials moved from the Yongsan presidential office to Cheong Wa Dae at the end of December last year, they said, "The presidential residence will also be moved no later than the first half of the year." However, as of the 21st, it has been confirmed that construction on the residence within Cheong Wa Dae has still not been completed. Attention is now focused on when President Lee and his wife will move into the residence. <<> According to a comprehensive report by this newspaper, construction on the Cheong Wa Dae residence is known to be ongoing for infrastructure development and wall reinforcement. President Lee began official duties at Cheong Wa Dae at the end of December last year, six months after taking office, yet renovation work on the presidential residence has continued for over a year. <<> Originally, Cheong Wa Dae aimed to complete renovations and move in during the first half of this year. However, the construction deadline is being delayed. A Cheong Wa Dae official said, "We are trying to complete the residence construction within this year," adding, "There are many cracks in the walls and roof tiles, the wood is rotting, and the pipes have burst, so basic infrastructure reinforcement is necessary." <<> According to Cheong Wa Dae, the presidential residence had been left as an 'empty house' after former President Yoon Suk Yeol moved the presidential office from Cheong Wa Dae to Yongsan right after the 2022 presidential election, declaring he would "open the Yongsan era," and after Cheong Wa Dae was opened to the public, it was significantly damaged by tourists and others. This has caused the construction to grow larger than expected and the timeline to stretch longer. The budget has also exceeded initial estimates, causing considerable concern within Cheong Wa Dae. A ruling party official said, "I understand that the extent of damage to the residence made it difficult to proceed with construction easily," adding, "Also, until the presidential office's move to Cheong Wa Dae was completed, the residence construction did not proceed properly, which contributed to the delay." It is reported that First Lady Kim Hye-kyung inspected the construction site after work began. <<> According to data submitted to Rep. Na Kyung-won of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly's Special Committee on Budget and Accounts, from the presidential office, construction costs for relocating President Lee Jae-myung's office to Cheong Wa Dae amounted to a total of 22.3 billion won in the second half of last year. However, costs for the residence relocation and interior work have not yet been disclosed. <<> Meanwhile, data submitted to Rep. Kim Eun-hye of the People Power Party from Jongno-gu Office shows that Cheong Wa Dae is carrying out construction to install an elevator in a hanok (traditional Korean house) whose purpose has been listed as a residence. The specific work involves demolishing the stairs and installing an elevator and new stairs. The building is a one-story structure with a basement level, and construction was reported to have begun on April 13, with completion expected next month. A People Power Party official said, "President Lee, who promised to move the Sejong office within his term, why has he been carrying out construction on the Cheong Wa Dae residence for over a year?" adding, "In particular, why is an elevator being installed in a building presumed to be the residence, and if this is delaying the move into the residence, the government must provide an explanation that the public can understand." However, a Cheong Wa Dae official said, "I've never heard about installing an elevator." <<> As construction has been delayed, President Lee and his wife are currently staying at the Hannam-dong residence that former President Yoon had prepared. The president frequently hosts official dinner events there as well. The Democratic Party had previously criticized the residence as a 'lavish palace,' claiming that during the Yoon administration, the former president and his wife used taxpayer money to build facilities including a bathroom with a hinoki (cypress) bathtub. A ruling party official said, "President Lee and his wife were initially reluctant to move into the Hannam-dong residence, but after living there for over a year, they seem to have grown accustomed to it now." (이재명 대통령이 작년 6월 취임 이후 1년 3개월 가까이 서울 용산 한남동 관저에서 지내며 청와대로 출퇴근을 하고 있다. 청와대 관계자들은 작년 12월 말 용산 대통령실에서 청와대로 이사할 당시 “대통령 관저 역시 늦어도 상반기에는 옮길 것”이라고 했었다. 하지만 21일 현재 청와대 내 관저 공사가 아직까지 끝나지 않은 것으로 확인됐다. 이 대통령 부부가 언제 관저로 들어갈 지를 두고 관심이 쏠리고 있다.)

item.title: "Acts That Destroy the Constitutional Order Are More Serious Than Corruption" (“헌정질서 파괴 행위, 반부패보다 더 심각”)
item.description:
"Acts That Destroy the Constitutional Order Are More Serious Than Corruption" (“헌정질서 파괴 행위, 반부패보다 더 심각”)

President Lee Jae-myung said at the first Anti-Corruption Policy Council meeting held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae on the 21st, "Recently, acts that destroy the constitutional order are more serious than corruption," adding, "While fake news is rampant, we need to discuss the causes of and solutions for a society where only extremes exist and there is no middle ground." (이재명 대통령은 21일 청와대에서 열린 제1차 반부패정책협의회에서 “최근에는 반부패보다 헌정질서 파괴 행위가 더 심각하다”며 “가짜뉴스가 횡행하는 한편, 양극단만 있고 중간이 없어지는 사회의 원인과 대책을 논의해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Although President Lee did not specifically mention what "acts that destroy the constitutional order" referred to, it was interpreted as a remark bearing in mind the "martial law crisis" that occurred two years ago. Earlier this month, when President Lee mentioned the need to integrate the army, navy, and air force academies, he also noted that those from the Korea Military Academy (KMA) had staged a military coup in the past, saying, "Even though they committed acts that completely destroyed the constitutional order, don't they still hold an overwhelming position (in the KMA)?" (이 대통령이 ‘헌정질서 파괴 행위’가 무엇인지 구체적으로 언급하지는 않았지만, 재작년 벌어진 ‘비상계엄 사태’ 등을 염두에 둔 발언으로 해석됐다. 이 대통령은 이달 초 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 필요성을 언급할 때도 육사 출신들이 과거 군사 쿠데타를 일으켰다며 “헌정질서를 통째로 파괴하는 행위를 저질렀음에도 여전히 (육사가) 압도적 위치를 차지하고 있지 않나”라고 했었다.)

Some in the ruling camp suggested the remark was aimed at Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, who has been in conflict with Cheong Wa Dae over the recent recommendation of Supreme Court justice nominees. However, a Cheong Wa Dae official asked regarding this view, "Please do not overinterpret it." (여권 일각에서는 최근 대법관 임명 제청을 두고 청와대와 갈등을 빚고 있는 조희대 대법원장을 겨냥한 언급이라는 말도 나왔다. 하지만 이 같은 견해에 대해 청와대 관계자는 “확대 해석하지 말아달라”고 했다.)

In his opening remarks at the meeting that day, President Lee said, "We need to closely examine and eradicate the corruption that remains in the political sphere, even though it has improved a lot," and "When it comes to eradicating corruption, there can be no ruling party versus opposition, no your side versus my side." This is the first time President Lee has directly mentioned "eradicating corruption" in the political sphere. (이 대통령은 이날 회의 모두 발언에서는 “많이 좋아졌지만 여전히 잔존하고 있는 정치권의 부패를 잘 살펴보고 청산해 가야 된다”며 “부패 청산에는 여야, 네 편 내 편이 있을 수 없다”고 했다. 이 대통령이 정치권 ‘부패 청산’을 직접 언급한 건 처음이다.)

President Lee said, "As of 2025, South Korea's integrity index ranks 31st out of 182 countries," adding, "Everything else ranks within the top 10, but it is somewhat shameful that only our integrity index ranks 31st." (이 대통령은 “2025년 기준으로 182개국 중에서 대한민국 청렴도가 31위라고 한다”며 “다른 건 다 10위 안에 들어 있는데 청렴도만 31위라고 하는 건 조금은 부끄러운 일”이라고 했다.)

President Lee said, "South Korea's economic standing is rising so much that we may not fully realize it ourselves," adding, "No matter how brilliant economic indicators we achieve, if people's livelihoods are difficult and the government and public service fail to earn the trust of the people, all these achievements could easily collapse like a castle built on sand." He continued, "The larger the economy and national power grow, the stricter the standards applied to transparency in the public sector and integrity in the public service," adding, "People's expectations are rising, but we need to examine whether there are areas we have been turning a blind eye to with excuses like 'this has been going on since the past' or 'this is a past practice,' and if such areas exist, they must be corrected immediately." (이 대통령은 “우리 스스로 충분히 느끼지 못하고 있을 만큼 대한민국의 경제적 위상이 매우 높아지고 있다”며 “아무리 화려한 경제지표를 달성하더라도 민생이 어렵고, 또 정부와 공직 사회가 국민으로부터 신뢰를 확보하지 못하면 이 모든 성과들은 마치 모래 위의 성처럼 쉽게 무너질 수도 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “경제 규모와 국력이 커질수록 공공 부문의 투명성, 공직 사회의 청렴성에는 더욱 엄격한 기준이 적용된다”며 “국민 눈높이는 높아지고 있는데 ‘과거부터 있던 일이다’ 혹은 ‘과거의 관행이다’라는 핑계를 대며 눈을 감고 있던 부분은 없는지 잘 살피고, 그런 부분이 있다면 즉시 시정해야 한다”고 했다.)

At the first meeting that day, measures to eradicate entrenched local corruption, corruption in public contracts, fraudulent receipt of subsidies, and collusion involving former officials were discussed intensively. President Lee said, "It is necessary to address these matters fairly, strictly, and without exception based on clear principles," and added, "I ask that you push forward unwaveringly until our people can feel that 'things have truly changed now.'" (이날 1차 회의에서는 토착 비리, 공공계약 비리, 보조금 부정 수급, 전관 유착 근절 방안이 집중 논의됐다. 이 대통령은 “명확한 원칙을 가지고 예외 없이 공정하게 그리고 엄정하게 정리해 나가는 게 필요하다”며 “우리 국민이 ‘이제 진짜 달라졌구나’라고 느낄 수 있을 때까지 흔들림 없이 추진해 주기를 당부한다”고 했다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik Thanks U.S. Ambassador Steel for "Donation" of Books During Korean War; Steel Clarifies "It Was a Loan" (조정식 “6·25 때 책 기증 감사” 스틸 美대사 “대여였다”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik Thanks U.S. Ambassador Steel for "Donation" of Books During Korean War; Steel Clarifies "It Was a Loan" (조정식 “6·25 때 책 기증 감사” 스틸 美대사 “대여였다”)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik met with newly appointed U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel at the National Assembly on the 21st. (조정식 국회의장은 21일 국회에서 최근 부임한 미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사를 만났다.)

In his opening remarks that day, Speaker Woo told Ambassador Steel, "Having demonstrated extensive experience and capability in U.S. politics, including as a federal congresswoman, and possessing deep understanding and affection for Korea, I expect you will be a great force in the development of the Korea-U.S. relationship." Ambassador Steel is a Korean-American born in Seoul in 1955 and served four years as a federal congresswoman starting in 2021. (조 의장은 이날 인사말을 통해 스틸 대사에게 “연방 하원의원 등 미국 정계에서 많은 경륜과 역량을 발휘해왔고, 한국에 대해서 깊은 이해와 애정을 갖고 있기 때문에 앞으로 한미 관계 발전에 큰 힘이 될 거라고 기대한다”고 했다. 스틸 대사는 1955년 서울에서 태어난 한국계로, 2021년부터 4년간 연방 하원의원을 지냈다.)

During their conversation, Speaker Woo mentioned, "The National Assembly of the Republic of Korea holds a very important legacy symbolizing Korea-U.S. friendship," noting that in 1951, during the Korean War, the U.S. Embassy donated 700 books to the National Assembly in its wartime refuge. Speaker Woo said, "This became a crucial starting point for our National Assembly Library." (대화 도중 조 의장은 “대한민국 국회에는 한미 우호를 상징하는 아주 중요한 유산이 있다”며 1951년 6·25전쟁 당시 미 대사관이 피란 국회에 책 700권을 기증했다고 언급했다. 조 의장은 “이것이 우리 국회도서관이 출발하는 중요한 계기가 됐다”고 했다.)

In response, Ambassador Steel said, "You mentioned the U.S. Embassy 'donated' 700 books, but as far as I know, it was a 'loan.' I understand that we received them back." She emphasized that it was a loan, not a donation. At this, Speaker Woo and other attendees burst into laughter. (이에 스틸 대사가 “(미 대사관이) 책 700권을 ‘기증’했다고 했는데, 제가 알기로는 ‘대여’를 한 걸로 알고 있다”며 “저희가 다시 돌려받는 것으로 이해하고 있다”고 말했다. 기증이 아니라 대여라는 걸 강조한 것이다. 이 말에 조 의장을 비롯한 참석자들이 웃음을 터뜨리기도 했다.)

The two discussed ways to develop the Korea-U.S. alliance and promote exchange and cooperation between the two countries' legislatures that day. Speaker Woo said, "I deeply empathize with and highly appreciate President Trump's will and determination to open a channel for dialogue on the chilled Korean Peninsula and establish a stable peace regime." He added, "This year marks the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States and the 73rd anniversary of the Korea-U.S. alliance. I hope the friendship and cooperation between our two countries, which have together defended the values of freedom and democracy, will grow even stronger in the future." (두 사람은 이날 한미동맹 발전과 양국 의회 간 교류와 협력 방안을 논의했다. 조 의장은 “특히 냉각돼 있는 한반도에 대화의 물꼬를 트고 한반도의 안정적 평화 체제를 구축하기 위한 트럼프 대통령의 의지와 결단에 깊이 공감하며 이를 높이 평가한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “올해는 미국 건국 250주년이자 한미 동맹 73주년이 되는 해”라며 “그동안 자유와 민주주의 가치를 함께 지켜온 양국의 우정과 협력이 앞으로 더욱 굳건해지기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Steel said, "Having worked in Congress, I understand firsthand the crucial role legislatures play in shaping foreign policy and international relations." She added, "I hope my experience as a lawmaker can serve as an opportunity for both the National Assembly and the U.S. Congress to deeply understand how each other operates. I look forward to working closely with Speaker Woo." (스틸 대사는 “제가 의회에서 일한 경험이 있기 때문에 외교 정책과 국제 관계를 형성하는 데 있어 (의회가) 얼마나 중요한 역할을 하는지 온몸으로 이해하고 있다”고 했다. 또 “의원으로서 일한 경험이 어떻게 국회와 미국 의회가 작동하는지 서로 깊이 이해할 수 있는 계기가 되길 바란다”며 “조 의장과 함께 긴밀하게 협력하기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo, who previously served as co-chair of the National Assembly's Korea-U.S. Parliamentary Friendship Association, said, "It would be great if the U.S. Congress had a group similar to the 'Korea-U.S. Parliamentary Friendship Association,' but there is no proper counterpart at the moment. I think it would greatly benefit the bilateral relationship if one were established in the future." Ambassador Steel responded, "If I can be of any help, I would gladly offer my assistance." That day, Speaker Woo presented a plaque of appreciation to the U.S. Embassy, and Ambassador Steel said "Thank you" in Korean. <<>> (국회 한미의원연맹 공동회장을 맡았던 조 의장은 “미국 의회에도 ‘미한의원연맹’ 같은 그룹이 있으면 좋겠는데 마땅한 카운터파트가 없는 상황”이라며 “앞으로 생기면 양국 관계에 더 큰 도움이 될 거라고 생각한다”고 했다. 스틸 대사는 “제가 일조할 수 있다면 적극적으로 도움을 드리고 싶다”고 화답했다. 조 의장은 이날 미 대사관에 감사패를 수여했고, 스틸 대사는 한국어로 “감사합니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House directly attacks Cho Hee-dae… "One-way notification of Supreme Court justice nomination" (靑 직접 나서 조희대 공격… “대법관 제청 일방통보”)
item.description:
Blue House directly attacks Cho Hee-dae… "One-way notification of Supreme Court justice nomination" (靑 직접 나서 조희대 공격… “대법관 제청 일방통보”)

Regarding Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae's nomination of Son Bong-ki, a senior judge at the Daegu District Court, as a Supreme Court justice candidate on the 18th, the Blue House directly criticized the Supreme Court on the 21st, saying, "It was a unilateral notification that skipped consultation and did not respect the president's appointment authority." The Democratic Party of Korea has been pressuring Chief Justice Cho to step down, claiming he broke with 'convention' by submitting the candidate in writing without prior consultation with the Blue House, and the Blue House has now joined in. However, within the legal community, citing that the constitutional nomination authority of the Supreme Court chief justice and the appointment authority of the president are equal, there has been criticism that "demanding the chief justice's resignation over convention is a political offensive." (조희대 대법원장이 지난 18일 대법관 후보자로 손봉기 대구지법 부장판사를 임명 제청한 데 대해, 청와대는 21일 “협의를 건너뛰고 대통령의 임명권을 존중하지 않은 일방 통보였다”고 대법원을 직격했다. 더불어민주당은 조 대법원장이 ‘관례’를 깨고 청와대와 사전 협의 없이 후보자를 서면 제청했다며 사퇴를 압박하고 있는 가운데, 청와대가 여기에 가세한 것이다. 하지만 법조계에서는 헌법상 대법원장의 제청권과 대통령의 임명권이 동등하다는 점을 들어 “관례를 이유로 대법원장에게 사퇴를 요구하는 건 정치 공세”라는 비판이 나왔다.)

Seong Ki-hong, the Blue House senior secretary for public relations and communication, appeared on YouTube's OhmyTV that day and described Chief Justice Cho's nomination as "an unprecedented situation in constitutional history." He also strongly denied claims made by Noh Kyoung-pil, the head of the National Court Administration, who had appeared before the National Assembly saying, "We requested a meeting with the president but had no opportunity" and "We submitted the nomination in writing in consultation with the Blue House's senior secretary for civil affairs," calling both "completely untrue." Seong said, "There was no consultation at all on the specific method of nomination, such as whether to submit it in writing," and described it as "a pattern deviating from established convention, a very serious situation." This was the first time a senior Blue House official directly stepped forward to attack the Supreme Court since Chief Justice Cho's nomination on the 18th. (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 유튜브 오마이TV에 출연해 조 대법원장의 임명 제청에 대해 “전례가 없는 헌정사 초유의 상황”이라고 했다. 그러면서 최근 노경필 대법원 법원행정처장이 국회에 나와 “대통령과 면담을 요구했지만 기회가 없었다” “청와대 민정수석과 협의하에 서면 제청했다”고 주장한 것도 “둘 다 전혀 사실이 아니다”라고 강하게 부인했다. 성 수석은 “서면 제청 여부 등 구체적인 제청 방식에 대해 전혀 협의 자체가 없었다”며 “기존 관례를 벗어난 패턴으로 매우 엄중한 상황”이라고 했다. 지난 18일 조 대법원장의 임명 제청 이후 청와대 고위 관계자가 직접 나서서 대법원을 저격한 건 이날 처음이다.)

President Lee Jae-myung is reportedly actively considering not sending the appointment consent motion for Judge Son to the National Assembly. (이재명 대통령은 국회에 손 부장판사의 임명 동의안을 보내지 않는 방안을 적극 검토하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

◇Legal community "No prior consultation provision in the Constitution"… Democratic Party "The National Court Administration should be abolished" (◇법조계 “헌법에 사전 협의 규정 없어”… 민주당은 “법원행정처 폐지해야”)

The ruling camp is pressuring Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, saying, "It is convention for the president and the Supreme Court chief justice to reach prior agreement on Supreme Court justice candidates." Seong Ki-hong, the Blue House senior secretary for public relations and communication, said that day regarding Chief Justice Cho's nomination without prior agreement, "Because there is no precedent, we are reviewing various conventions since 1987 and examining legal aspects while deliberating on how to handle this situation." (여권은 “대통령과 대법원장이 대법관 후보자를 사전 합의하는 것이 관례”라며 조희대 대법원장을 압박하고 있다. 성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 조 대법원장의 사전 합의 없는 임명 제청에 대해 “전례가 없기 때문에 1987년 이후의 여러 관례를 살펴보고 법률적인 부분들도 검토해 나가면서 이 사태를 어떻게 다뤄야 할지 숙고하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Supreme Court's claim that it had "requested a meeting with the president but was refused," Seong said, "We only gave a general response that we would discuss it when consultation took place, but they spun it that way," adding, "It is not true." Following a notice the previous evening strongly criticizing the Supreme Court's nomination process as "an unprecedented situation in constitutional history," the Blue House escalated its confrontation through the senior secretary's remarks that day. (성 수석은 대법원 측이 ‘대통령과 면담을 신청했지만 거절당했다’고 한 데 대해서도 “협의가 되면 그때 논의하자는 일반적인 답변을 한 것에 불과한데 그걸 그런 식으로 말하더라”며 “사실과 다르다”고 했다. 청와대는 전날 저녁 공지를 통해 대법원의 이번 임명 제청 절차를 “전례가 없는 헌정사 초유의 상황”이라며 강하게 비판한 데 이어, 이날은 홍보수석의 입을 통해 대법원과 대립각을 세웠다.)

However, many in the legal community and academia believe it is difficult to see substantive or procedural defects in Chief Justice Cho's nomination process. This is because neither the Constitution nor statutes require prior agreement with the president or a direct meeting to seek consent when nominating Supreme Court justice candidates. Article 104 of the Constitution stipulates, "Supreme Court justices shall be appointed by the President with the consent of the National Assembly, upon the nomination of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court." Under the principle of separation of powers, the nomination authority is given to the chief justice, consent authority to the National Assembly, and final appointment authority to the president, and the mainstream view in academia is that the chief justice was given nomination authority to prevent excessive political interference. (하지만 법조계와 학계에선 조 대법원장의 제청 절차에 실질적·절차적 하자가 있다고 보기 어렵다는 의견이 많다. 헌법과 법률에 대법관 후보자를 제청할 때 대통령과 사전 합의를 거쳐야 한다거나 직접 만나 동의를 구해야 한다는 규정은 없기 때문이다. 헌법 104조는 ‘대법관은 대법원장의 제청으로 국회의 동의를 얻어 대통령이 임명한다’고 규정하고 있다. 삼권분립 원칙에 따라 대법원장에게 제청권, 국회에 동의권, 대통령에게 최종 임명권을 나눠 준 것으로, 정치권의 과도한 개입을 막기 위해 대법원장에게 대법관 제청권을 줬다는 게 학계 주류의 의견이다.)

One opposition figure said that prior coordination between the chief justice and the president "could actually function as pressure by the appointing authority on the nominating authority, so it should be guarded against." They also noted that it was only during the Roh Moo-hyun administration that the president and chief justice first publicly engaged in prior coordination, so it cannot be considered a long-standing convention that takes precedence over the Constitution. (한 야권 인사는 대법원장과 대통령의 사전 조율은 “오히려 임명권자의 제청권자에 대한 압력으로 작용할 수 있어서 경계해야 한다”고 했다. 대통령과 대법원장이 만나 공개적으로 사전 조율에 나선 건 노무현 정부 때가 처음이어서 헌법에 앞서는 오랜 관례로 볼 수 없다고도 했다.)

However, the ruling camp unanimously pressured Chief Justice Cho to resign voluntarily. Kim Min-seok, the Democratic Party of Korea representative, on the 19th made the call for Chief Justice Cho's resignation his first order of business upon taking office. At the Supreme Council meeting on the 21st, he also said, "The Chief Justice Cho issue is not something for the National Assembly to get excited about, but for the judiciary to get excited about," urging Supreme Court justices and trial judges to discuss the matter of Chief Justice Cho's position and take measures that the public can accept. Hardliners within the Democratic Party continued to argue for Chief Justice Cho's impeachment. Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon said, "There are sufficient grounds for impeachment," and called for considering pursuing impeachment, while Supreme Council member Han Min-soo said that if Chief Justice Cho does not step down, "We will strongly push forward with countermeasures at the National Assembly level." Within the Democratic Party, there have also been arguments to abolish the current National Court Administration and downgrade it to a 'Court Affairs Office.' On the 31st, the Democratic Party also pushed through a motion to summon Chief Justice Cho as a witness before the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, despite opposition from the opposition party. (그러나 여권은 한목소리로 조 대법원장에게 자진 사퇴하라고 압박했다. 김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 지난 19일 취임 일성으로 조 대법원장 사퇴를 요구했다. 21일 최고위원회의에서도 “조 대법원장 문제는 국회가 흥분할 일이 아니고 사법부가 흥분할 일”이라며 대법관과 일선 판사들에게 조 대법원장 거취 문제를 논의해 국민이 납득할 조치를 하라고 했다. 민주당 강경파들은 조 대법원장 탄핵 주장을 계속했다. 이성윤 최고위원은 “탄핵 사유는 충분하다”며 탄핵 추진 검토를 요구했고, 한민수 최고위원도 조 대법원장이 물러나지 않으면 “국회 차원의 대응책을 강력하게 추진하겠다”고 했다. 민주당 내에서는 현재의 법원행정처를 폐지하고 ‘법원사무처’로 격하시키자는 주장도 나왔다. 민주당은 31일 조 대법원장을 국회 법사위 증인으로 부르는 안도 야당 반대 속에 강행 처리했다.)

The People Power Party said, "The most urgent matter right now is not summoning the chief justice but the Blue House submitting the appointment consent motion," adding, "But the Democratic Party says nothing to the Blue House while trying to put the chief justice, who exercised his constitutional authority, on the witness stand. The order is completely backwards." Spokesperson Ham In-kyung said in a commentary that because Chief Justice Cho did not recommend a candidate favored by the Blue House, the entire ruling camp has launched a 'witch hunt against the chief justice,' and "trying to nullify the chief justice's constitutional nomination authority in order to make someone the president wants into a Supreme Court justice is truly shaking the very foundation of the separation of powers." (국민의힘은 “지금 가장 긴급한 것은 대법원장 소환이 아니라 청와대의 임명 동의안 제출”이라며 “그러나 민주당은 청와대에는 아무 말도 하지 않으면서 헌법상 권한을 행사한 대법원장부터 증언대에 세우려고 한다. 순서가 바뀌어도 한참 뒤바뀌었다”고 했다. 함인경 대변인은 논평을 통해, 조 대법원장이 청와대가 점찍어 둔 후보자를 추천하지 않자 여권 전체가 ‘대법원장 찍어내기’에 나섰다며 “대통령이 원하는 사람을 대법관으로 만들기 위해 대법원장의 헌법상 제청권까지 무력화하려 하는 것은 그야말로 삼권분립의 근간을 흔드는 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Following UFS... Joint ROK-US Marine Exercise Involving 10,000 Troops Also Canceled (UFS 이어… 한미 해병 1만명 연합훈련도 취소)
item.description:
Following UFS... Joint ROK-US Marine Exercise Involving 10,000 Troops Also Canceled (UFS 이어… 한미 해병 1만명 연합훈련도 취소)

It was confirmed on the 21st that the ROK-US military authorities canceled the combined naval and marine exercise (Ssangyong Exercise) that had been scheduled for September. The Ssangyong Exercise is a division-level combined exercise involving more than 10,000 ROK and US troops and is held every two years. The US side reportedly conveyed to the ROK side that it would be difficult to mobilize troops for the exercise due to the fallout of the Iran War. (한미 군 당국이 9월 실시 예정이던 양국 해군·해병대 연합훈련(쌍룡훈련)을 취소한 것으로 21일 확인됐다. 쌍룡훈련은 한미 장병 1만명 이상이 참여하는 사단급 연합훈련으로 2년에 한번 실시된다. 미국 측은 이란전쟁 여파로 훈련에 병력을 동원하기 어렵다는 입장을 한국 측에 전달한 것으로 알려졌다.)

A military source said, "As a significant number of US Navy and Marine Corps personnel moved to the Middle East due to the Iran War fallout, the US side requested adjustments to the exercise plan in June, and the exercise schedule was canceled in July." The ROK military plans to conduct a division-level amphibious landing exercise independently in late September. (군 소식통은 “미 해군·해병대 장병 상당수가 이란전쟁 여파로 중동으로 이동하면서 지난 6월 미측이 훈련 계획 조정을 요청해왔고, 7월 훈련 일정이 취소됐다”고 했다. 한국군은 9월 하순 단독으로 사단급 상륙훈련을 실시할 예정이다.)

The Ssangyong Exercise is a drill that assumes a scenario similar to the Incheon Landing Operation during the Korean War, where large-scale forces land on an enemy coast and advance inland. While the Navy and Marine Corps are the main participants, the Army and Air Force also provide support. Between 10,000 and 20,000 ROK and US troops have participated in the exercise. A security official said, "The cancellation of the Ssangyong Exercise appears unrelated to any intention to improve US-North Korea relations, but it serves as a preview of the situation Korea could face when US interests are at stake in other regions of the world." (쌍룡훈련은 6·25 당시 인천상륙작전처럼 대규모 병력이 적 해안에 상륙하고 내륙으로 진출하는 상황을 상정한 훈련이다. 해군과 해병대가 주축이지만 육군과 공군도 지원한다. 훈련에는 한미 양국 장병 1만~2만명이 참여해왔다. 안보 관계자는 “쌍룡훈련 취소는 미·북 관계 개선 의도와는 무관해 보이지만, 세계 다른 지역에 미국의 이익이 걸렸을 때 한국이 처할 상황을 보여 주는 예고편”이라고 했다.)

The 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) exercise, which used to involve around 18,000 ROK and US troops each summer, ended early on the 21st on a reduced scale. It was originally scheduled to run from the 17th to the 27th, but US President Donald Trump, emphasizing his closeness with North Korea, publicly ordered its reduction. The computer simulation-based command post exercise (CPX) omitted the 'counterattack operation' phase that was typically conducted in the latter part of the exercise. According to the Joint Chiefs of Staff, only 7 of the 14 planned combined field training exercises will be conducted by the 28th. Last year, ROK and US military authorities conducted 44 field training exercises in conjunction with UFS, a number that has now been reduced to 7 this year. (매년 여름 한미 장병 1만8000여명이 참여하던 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS) 훈련은 규모가 축소된 채 21일 조기 종료했다. 17~27일까지 실시될 예정이었지만 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령이 북한과 친밀감을 강조하며 공개적으로 축소를 지시했다. 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 기반 지휘소훈련(CPX)은 훈련 후반에 실시하는 ‘반격 작전’을 생략했다. 합참에 따르면 한미 연합 야외기동훈련도 예정된 14건 가운데 7건만 오는 28일까지 실시된다. 한미 군당국은 지난해 UFS와 연계해 44건의 야외기동훈련을 실시했는데, 올해는 7건으로 줄어든 셈이다.)

The ROK and US plan to conduct the combined air exercise 'Freedom Flag' and the nuclear-conventional integrated tabletop exercise 'Iron Mace' in the latter half of this year. However, with North Korea demanding a halt to ROK-US combined exercises and President Trump showing interest in a US-North Korea summit, concerns are growing within and outside the military that these exercises may not proceed as planned. (한미는 올 하반기 한미 공중연합훈련인 ‘프리덤 플래그’, 핵·재래식통합 도상훈련인 ‘아이언메이스’ 등을 실시할 계획이다. 하지만 북한이 한미 연합훈련 중단을 요구하고 있고, 트럼프 미 대통령이 미·북 정상회담에 관심을 보이면서 정상 진행이 어려운 게 아니냐는 우려가 군 안팎에서 커지고 있다.)

◇ Ended without even the 'Let's go together' chant... "Possibility of further reductions in ROK-US exercises" (◇‘같이 갑시다’ 구호도 없이 끝났다… “한미훈련 더 줄일 가능성”)

This year's 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) exercise ended on the 21st, just five days after it began. The commemorative photo opportunity between the commander of US Forces Korea and the ROK Joint Chiefs of Staff chairman was also gone, as were the chants "Fight Tonight" and "Let's go together" that ROK-US military leaders had shouted every year. With the theater-level exercise UFS and the Ssangyong Exercise, which included large-scale amphibious operations, being reduced and canceled in succession, military officials and security experts expressed concern that the readiness posture against North Korea is inevitably weakening. (올해 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS) 훈련이 시작한지 5일 만인 21일 끝났다. 주한미군 사령관과 한국 합참의장의 기념사진 촬영도, 매년 한미 군 수뇌부가 외쳤던 “파이트 투나잇”(오늘밤 싸운다), “같이 갑시다” 구호도 사라졌다. 전구급(戰區級) 훈련인 UFS, 대규모 상륙작전이 포함된 쌍룡훈련이 잇따라 축소, 취소되면서 군 당국자와 안보 전문가들은 대북 대비 태세가 약화할 수밖에 없다고 우려했다.)

◇ Ssangyong Exercise canceled due to US troop deployment to the Middle East (◇미군 중동 파병에 취소된 쌍룡훈련)

In military circles, the prolonged Iran war was cited as the background for the US canceling the Ssangyong Exercise two to three months ahead of the drill. The redeployment of forces from the Indo-Pacific region, such as the 2,500 troops of the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit based in Okinawa, Japan, who were deployed to the Middle East along with the amphibious assault ship USS Tripoli earlier this year, had an impact. The Ssangyong Exercise typically involved large-scale US forces, including amphibious assault ships, F-35B stealth fighters of the US Marine Corps, and Apache attack helicopters. In the midst of the Middle East war, it was not easy to pull forces out to conduct a large-scale exercise in Korea. (군에선 미국이 훈련 2~3개월을 앞두고 쌍룡훈련을 취소한 배경으로 이란 전쟁 장기화를 꼽았다. 올 상반기 일본 오키나와에 배치된 제31해병원정대 병력 2500명이 강습상륙함 트리폴리와 함께 중동에 배치되는 등 인도·태평양에 배치된 전력이 재배치된 것이 영향을 줬다는 것이다. 쌍룡훈련에는 통상 미측 강습상륙함, 미 해병대 스텔스 전투기 F-35B, 아파치 공격헬기 등 대규모 미군 전력이 투입된다. 중동 전쟁 상황에서 전력을 빼 한국에서 대규모 훈련을 하기는 쉽지 않은 상황이었다는 것이다.)

The US recently redeployed the aircraft carrier USS George Washington, which had been stationed in the Pacific, to the Middle East. This was to rotate with the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been deployed in the Iran war for nine months. The prolonged Iran war is creating a security vacuum in the East Asian region. (미국은 최근 이란과의 전쟁을 위해 태평양에 배치됐던 항공모함 조지 워싱턴을 중동으로 재배치했다. 9개월째 이란전에 투입된 에이브러햄 링컨함과 교대하기 위해서다. 장기화된 이란 전쟁이 동아시아 지역에 안보 공백을 만들어내고 있는 것이다.)

A former senior Defense Ministry official said, "The cancellation of the Ssangyong Exercise can be seen as a result of the US, which is at war in the Middle East, applying 'strategic flexibility' to its Indo-Pacific forces," adding, "It is important to maintain a ROK-US relationship that ensures US forces from other regions will be deployed to the Korean Peninsula in the event of a contingency here." A military source said, "There is a sense that the Korean Peninsula keeps slipping down the US priority list," adding, "It is telling that the US did not cancel other multinational exercises like RIMPAC or Kamandag, but canceled bilateral ROK-US exercises." RIMPAC is a multinational maritime exercise led by the US Navy held around the Pacific Rim, and Kamandag is a multinational exercise led by US and Philippine Marine Corps forces conducted in the Philippines. (전직 국방부 고위관계자는 “쌍룡훈련 취소는 중동에서 전쟁 중인 미국이 인도·태평양 전력에 대해 ‘전략적 유연성’을 적용하면서 일어난 일로 볼 수 있다”며 “한반도 유사시에 다른 지역에 있는 미측 전력이 한반도에 전개된다는 보장을 받을 수 있는 한미 관계를 지켜나가는 것이 중요하다”고 했다. 군 소식통은 “미국의 우선순위에서 한반도가 계속 밀리는 분위기”라며 “미국은 림팩이나 카만닥 같은 다른 다국적 훈련은 취소하지 않았는데 한미 양자 훈련을 취소하는 것은 의미심장하다”고 했다. 림팩은 미국 해군 주도로 환태평양에서 열리는 다국적 해상 훈련이고, 카만닥은 미·필리핀 해병대 주도로 필리핀에서 실시되는 다국적 훈련이다.)

The Iran war could also lead to ROK-US friction. As US President Donald Trump announced he would launch an unprecedented 'economic isolation' campaign against Iran, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on the 20th (local time), "It's time to decide whether you are with us or against us," pressuring allies to join in. Trump has repeatedly singled out and criticized Korea for not responding to his request to send warships to protect freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. (이란 전쟁이 한미 갈등을 초래할 가능성도 있다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 이란에 대한 전례 없는 규모의 ‘경제 고립’ 작전에 나서겠다고 밝힌 가운데, 스콧 베선트 재무장관은 20일(현지 시각) “우리 편인지 우리에게 맞설 것인지 결정을 내려야 할 시점”이라며 동맹의 동참을 압박했다. 트럼프는 호르무즈 해협 항행(航行) 수호를 위한 군함 파견에 한국이 응하지 않자 한국을 콕 집어 여러 차례 비판했다.)

◇ Possibility of further reductions in second-half exercises (◇하반기 훈련도 축소 가능성)

A total of 14 field training exercises were planned to be conducted during this year's UFS period. However, only 7 of them will be conducted by the 28th. The remaining 7 exercises that will not be held during UFS are reportedly being discussed with the US side for 'distribution throughout the year.' Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek appeared before the National Assembly's Defense Committee the previous day and said, "A total of 159 field training exercises between Korea and the US are planned for this year," adding, "We will make efforts to maintain consistent training throughout the year even after UFS ends." (올해 UFS 기간 실시될 예정인 야외 기동훈련은 총 14건이었다. 하지만 이중 7건만 오는 28일까지 실시할 예정이다. UFS 시기 실시하지 않기로 한 나머지 7건도 일단 ‘연중 분산 시행’ 방향으로 미국 측과 협의하고 있다고 한다. 안규백 국방장관은 전날 국회 국방위원회에 출석해 “올해 한미 간 진행하는 야외기동훈련은 총 159회가 예정돼 있다”며 “UFS가 끝난 이후에도 훈련을 연중 균질하게 이어갈 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

However, ROK-US combined exercises are expected to be reduced more significantly than planned, not only due to the Middle East situation but also in connection with President Trump's moves to resume dialogue with North Korea. Professor Park Won-gon of Ewha Womans University said, "The US may continue its trend of reducing ROK-US combined exercises to resume dialogue with North Korea," adding, "It is highly likely that upcoming exercises will also be halted." With UFS, which North Korea has objected to the most, being scaled down, and the Ssangyong Exercise, which North Korea denounced as "amphibious landing drills aimed at advancing on Pyongyang," being canceled, exercises that North Korea has reacted sensitively to, such as the ROK-US nuclear-conventional integration (CNI) exercise 'Iron Mace,' could be the first to be canceled or postponed. (하지만 한미 연합훈련은 중동 상황 뿐 아니라 트럼프 미 대통령의 미·북 대화 재개 움직임과 연관돼 있어 계획보다 큰 폭으로 줄어들 것으로 전망된다. 박원곤 이화여대 교수는 “미국은 북한과의 대화 재개를 위해 계속해서 한미 연합훈련 축소 기조를 이어갈 수 있다”며 “앞으로 예정된 훈련들도 중단될 가능성이 높다”고 했다. 북한이 가장 반발해온 UFS가 축소됐고, “평양 진격을 노린 상륙작전 연습”이라고 비난한 쌍룡훈련이 취소된 가운데 한미의 핵·재래식 통합(CNI) 훈련인 ‘아이언메이스’ 등 북한이 민감하게 반응해온 훈련이 우선 취소, 연기될 수 있다는 것이다.)

◇ North Korea seeking to crack the ROK-US alliance (◇한미 동맹 균열 노리는 北)

Amid this situation, North Korea is attempting to drive a wedge into the ROK-US alliance. In a statement on the 20th, Kim Yo-jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, said, "It is the fate of a puppet army that has handed over its command authority to its master that it cannot even protest one word when US troops retreat under the unilateral orders of the US commander-in-chief without any coordination between the two sides." This highlights the frame of a 'master-subordinate relationship' between the ROK and the US. A diplomatic source said, "As Trump's America notifies allies of unilateral decisions without prior coordination and demands compensation rather than unconditionally guaranteeing security commitments, North Korea appears to be exploiting this situation to stir up 'self-reliance' sentiments in some segments of Korean society and provoke intra-Korean conflict." (이런 가운데 북한은 한미 동맹에 균열을 내려 시도하고 있다. 북한 김정은 국무위원장의 동생 김여정은 20일 담화를 통해 “미 통수권자의 일방적인 지령에 따라 쌍방 간 조율도 없이 미군이 꼬리를 사려도 항변 한마디 할 수 없는 것이 바로 지휘권을 상전에게 맡긴 허수아비 군대의 숙명”이라고 했다. 한미가 ‘주종 관계’라는 프레임을 부각시키는 것이다. 외교 소식통은 “트럼프의 미국이 동맹국과 사전 조율 없이 일방적인 결정을 통보하고, 안보 공약을 무조건 보장하기보다는 대가를 요구하는 상황을 파고들면서 한국 일각의 ‘자주’ 정서를 자극해 남남갈등을 유발하려는 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

item.title: Opposition Submits Disciplinary Motion Against People Power Party's Lee Jin-suk… "A Serious Provocation Against the Spirit of May 18" (與, 국힘 이진숙 징계안 제출… “5·18 정신에 중대한 도발”)
item.description:
Opposition Submits Disciplinary Motion Against People Power Party's Lee Jin-suk… "A Serious Provocation Against the Spirit of May 18" (與, 국힘 이진숙 징계안 제출… “5·18 정신에 중대한 도발”)

The Democratic Party of Korea submitted a disciplinary motion to the National Assembly on the 21st against Lee Jin-suk (Dalseong, Daegu), a lawmaker from the People Power Party. The reason is that the lawmaker co-hosted a forum at the National Assembly under the theme of "Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement," which disparaged the May 18 Democratization Movement. The Democratic Party has announced plans to form the National Assembly's Ethics Special Committee and pursue expulsion of the lawmaker. (더불어민주당이 21일 국민의힘 이진숙(대구 달성) 의원에 대한 징계안을 국회에 제출했다. 이 의원이 국회에서 ‘5·18 민주화운동 재조명’을 주제로 포럼을 공동 개최해 5·18 민주화운동을 폄훼했다는 이유다. 민주당은 국회 윤리특별위원회를 구성해 이 의원에 대한 제명까지 추진하겠다는 방침이다.)

The Democratic Party submitted the disciplinary motion against the lawmaker that day in the names of about 20 lawmakers, including Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's senior deputy chief whip. Rep. Ahn Do-geol, who chairs the Democratic Party's Gwangju-Jeonnam chapter, described the lawmaker's event as "a serious provocation that fundamentally challenges the spirit of May 18" and "a secondary harm to those who were sacrificed in May 18 and their bereaved families." (민주당은 이날 천준호 민주당 원내운영수석부대표 등 의원 20여 명 명의로 이 의원에 대한 징계안을 제출했다. 민주당 전남광주시당 위원장인 안도걸 의원은 이 의원 행사가 “5·18 정신에 근본적으로 도전하는 중대한 도발”이라며 “5·18로 희생된 분들, 유족들에 대한 2차 가해”라고 했다.)

Once the disciplinary motion is submitted, the National Assembly's Ethics Special Committee will review it. Disciplinary measures include warnings or apologies at open sessions, suspension of attendance, and expulsion. Expulsion of a lawmaker requires the approval of at least two-thirds of all sitting lawmakers under the Constitution. However, the National Assembly's Ethics Special Committee has not yet been formed. (징계안이 제출되면 국회 윤리특위가 심사하게 된다. 징계는 공개회의에서의 경고·사과, 출석 정지, 제명 등이 있다. 의원 제명에는 헌법에 따라 재적 의원 3분의 2 이상의 찬성이 필요하다. 다만 현재 국회 윤리특위는 구성되지 않은 상태다.)

The lawmaker held a public forum titled "Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement" at the National Assembly Library on the 13th. In her welcoming remarks, the lawmaker said, "Research on May 18 should be conducted more actively" and "It should not become the possession of a particular faction." However, among the attendees, remarks were made such as, "To resolve the Honam May 18 issue, it must be isolated externally and divided internally." (이 의원은 지난 13일 국회도서관에서 ‘5·18 민주화운동의 재조명’을 주제로 공개 포럼을 열었다. 이 의원은 환영사에서 “5·18에 대한 연구가 더 활발히 이뤄져야 한다”며 “특정 진영의 소유물이 돼서는 안 된다”고 했다. 다만 행사 참석자 사이에선 ‘호남 5·18 문제를 해결하려면 대외적으로는 고립시켜야 하고 내부적으로는 분열을 시켜야 한다’ 등의 발언이 나왔다)

The Democratic Party is also pushing for the passage of a revision to the National Assembly Act that would allow the long-term suspension of the lawmaker's duties. The revision recently proposed by Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Yong-woo includes provisions to suspend the duties of a National Assembly member who distorts or disparages the May 18 Democratization Movement for up to one year. In this regard, Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok also stated, "If expulsion is difficult under the current law due to the provision requiring a two-thirds quorum in the formation and processing of the Ethics Committee, it would be good to at least suspend qualifications through a majority vote at a plenary session." The Democratic Party is thus simultaneously pursuing both disciplinary action under the current National Assembly Act and the introduction of a new duty-suspension system. (민주당은 이 의원의 직무 수행을 장기간 정지할 수 있도록 하는 국회법 개정안 처리도 추진하고 있다. 이용우 민주당 의원이 최근 발의한 개정안은 5·18 민주화운동 등을 왜곡·폄훼한 국회의원의 직무 수행을 최대 1년간 정지할 수 있도록 하는 내용이다. 이와 관련, 김민석 민주당 대표도 “현행법상 윤리위 구성과 처리 절차에 있어 정족수의 3분의 2를 채워야 한다는 조항 때문에 (제명이) 어렵다면 국회 본회의를 통한 과반 의결로 자격 정지라도 하는 것이 좋다”고 했다. 민주당이 이 의원에 대한 현행 국회법상 징계와 별도로 새로운 직무정지 제도 도입까지 동시에 추진하는 것이다.)

An official from Lee Jin-suk's office addressed the ruling party's disciplinary push by saying, "The event was not held with the intention of disparaging May 18." <<>> (이진숙 의원실 관계자는 여당의 징계 추진에 대해 “5·18을 폄훼하려는 의도로 연 행사가 아니었다”고 했다.)
